title: Uniform and probability-mass-function norms
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $p\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. The $L^p$ norm of $f$ under the uniform probability mass function on $\Omega$ equals its uniform $L^p$ norm.
